review.posthog_relevance: Chat title generation performance and responsiveness in the PostHog UI, specifically for session transcripts.
review.reason: The change implements an incremental O(appended) prompt-counting hook replacing an O(n) walk, which could reduce UI thread blocking and improve responsiveness when session events arrive incrementally. This is a substantive, bounded performance improvement. Tests are added for regression protection. The implementation connects to the chat title generator workflow.
review.uncertainty: The actual runtime benefit and production impact depend on the frequency and volume of session transcript updates, which are not demonstrated by the code alone. No production incident or adoption data is available.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.
